content.text: {"answer":"Quarrendon Freight Lines","citations":["D106","D004","D056","D059"],"explanation":"In the 2025-09-15 North weekly (D106), \"Dana's freight account\" appears under the Quarrendon Freight Lines section, which says Dana is checking the 185-seat roster with Thea Ramaswell. Dana owned Quarrendon from 2025-06-02 (D004, D056). Brackenwater, the other freight account, moved from Dana to Marcus that same day and is described there as \"Marcus's freight account\"."}
